identity.title: Powered Industrial Truck Pre-Shift Inspection Log — Forklift FL-2 (Toyota 8FGU25), September 2026, Portland Warehouse

scan.summary: This is the Portland warehouse's daily pre-shift inspection log for forklift FL-2 (a propane Toyota 8FGU25) for September 2026, kept to satisfy the pre-shift examination requirement in 29 CFR 1910.178(q)(7). It shows a checklist of safety items ticked off by operators M.C. and J.R. for most weekdays from Sep 1 through Sep 17, with one noted defect (horn) on Sep 9. As a record, there is nothing to draft into it — what matters is whether every shift the truck was used is actually logged and whether noted defects were resolved before further use.
scan.freshness_note: The visible entries stop at Sep 17, 2026; today is Sep 27, 2026, so ten days of entries are not shown on this page. Confirm whether later September entries exist elsewhere in the log.

gaps.title: No logged inspection for Sep 3–4, 2026
gaps.description: Entries run Sep 1, Sep 2, then jump to Sep 7 with no rows for Thursday Sep 3 or Friday Sep 4, while the hour meter still climbed from 4,819 to 4,834 over that span, suggesting the truck was used without a recorded pre-shift check on those days.
gaps.fix: Determine whether FL-2 was operated on Sep 3–4; if so, obtain or reconstruct the missing inspection records and document why they were not completed contemporaneously, and reinforce the daily-log requirement with operators.
gaps.locator: table, rows between Sep 2 and Sep 7

gaps.title: Horn defect noted Sep 9 with no documented resolution
gaps.description: The Sep 9 row marks the horn as defective and notes it in writing, but there is no follow-up entry showing the truck was taken out of service, repaired, or verified safe before it was used again on Sep 10.
gaps.fix: Add a corrective-action note (repair date, who verified it, return-to-service confirmation) tied to the Sep 9 defect, and keep the maintenance record with this log.
gaps.citation: 29 CFR 1910.178(q)(7) — trucks with safety-affecting defects must not be used until corrected

facts.value: No pre-shift inspection entries recorded for Sep 3 or Sep 4, 2026 despite entries on the surrounding weekdays
facts.locator: table, rows between Sep 2 and Sep 7
facts.affects: Whether the daily pre-shift inspection requirement was met on those operating days; supports the existing known gap for this company.

facts.value: Horn recorded as defective on Sep 9, 2026 with no documented corrective action or return-to-service entry
facts.affects: Whether FL-2 was properly removed from service and repaired before continued use on Sep 10, relevant to 1910.178(q)(7).
